column1: # Container Apps secrets the deploy writes from GitHub Actions secrets (issue #68).
# One row per app secret. Columns (tab separated):
#   aca_secret   Container Apps secret name on that app
#   github       GitHub Actions secret (repository or environment) holding the value
#   env          container env var set to secretref:<aca_secret>
#   mode         legacy = written in every mode (today's identity mail pair)
#                github = written only when repository variable ACA_SECRETS_SOURCE=github
# Names only. Values never live in the repo.
